# googleworkspace_user (Resource)

Manages a Google Workspace user via the Admin SDK Directory API.

Custom schema values are supplied as JSON-encoded strings, so wrap each value in `jsonencode`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "googleworkspace_user" "developer" {
  primary_email = "ada@example.com"
  org_unit_path = "/Engineering"

  name {
    given_name  = "Ada"
    family_name = "Lovelace"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `primary_email` (String)

### Optional

- `archived` (Boolean)
- `custom_schemas` (Block List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--custom_schemas))
- `name` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--name))
- `org_unit_path` (String)
- `suspended` (Boolean)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedblock--custom_schemas"></a>
### Nested Schema for `custom_schemas`

Required:

- `schema_name` (String)
- `schema_values` (Map of String)


<a id="nestedblock--name"></a>
### Nested Schema for `name`

Required:

- `family_name` (String)
- `given_name` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The import ID is the user's primary email address or immutable user ID.
terraform import googleworkspace_user.developer ada@example.com
```
